assets.label: BC Timber Sales with the Forest Service oval
assets.publisher: BC Timber Sales, Ministry of Forests
assets.sourceLocator: PDF pages 2 and 15, front and back covers. Vector artwork recovered from page 15.
assets.notes: The Forest Service oval sits beside green BCTS initials and a dark serif subtitle. Both covers carry this lockup and a separate provincial coat-of-arms wordmark.
assets.fidelityNote: The 75 painted paths from the back cover retain their geometry and embedded colours. At 1064 × 448 pixels the silhouette overlap with the PDF rendering was 99.4–99.6% across three thresholds.

rights.note: The project maintainer confirmed rights-holder permission for PofBC to publish this extracted SVG and its transparent PNG download. Further reuse is outside that confirmation.
